newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bacob, National Bank of Canada to cooperate.
newsitem.headline: Bacob, National Bank of Canada to cooperate.

text.p: Belgian cooperative bank Bacob said on Friday it had signed a cooperation agreement with National Bank of Canada (NBC).
Bacob board member Walter Vanderbeken told a news conference that Bacob would act as a service centre for NBC's Belgian customers and vice versa.
The two banks will also cooperate on capital markets and have agreed to exchange financial know-how.
Bacob Chief Executive Dirk Bruneel said NBC was active in 20 states in the United States where it sells mortgage loans.
Bacob on the other hand is active in the securitisation of mortgage loans.
